summary: Boxlight filed an 8-K reporting a September 2, 2026 Nasdaq Hearings Panel decision that the company regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(b)(1), the $2.5 million stockholders' equity requirement, after an August 13, 2026 hearing. The panel granted continued listing but imposed a one-year Discretionary Panel Monitor effective August 17, 2026, meaning any new deficiency during the period skips the normal cure process and triggers a Delist Determination Letter. Compliance rested on a roughly $6.6 million PIPE, an anticipated $15 million equity line, and a planned $2.9 million debt-to-equity swap. Watch dilution risk and any new deficiency.
